paragraphs: Averhealth provides substance use monitoring and treatment solutions. Its work is built around the needs of criminal justice-based substance use monitoring programs.

Samples ship to the company's laboratory in St. Louis the same day, and results come back the next business day after testing. The laboratory is led by a PhD toxicologist. The company states that the lab is CAP-FDT, CLIA, and DEA accredited. Testing covers more than 1,500 substances in urine, oral fluid, hair, and sweat. Its software, Aversys, supports automated, individualized treatment and supervision programs in a paper-free form.

The company describes itself as more than just a drug testing provider. Its stated goal is to support customers as they work to drive sustainable behavioral changes. Averhealth, Avertest, and Aversys are registered trademarks or service marks of Avertest, LLC.
